| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| origin | DCode block |
| format | `task_periodic <portal>/<name>:` |
| detail | Create a DARTWIC periodic task block |

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `portal` | Task portal. If omitted in shorthand, DCode treats the name as `tasks/<name>`. |
| `name` | Task name. Letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens are accepted. |

## Body Sections

| Section | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `start:` | Optional setup block run when the task runtime starts. |
| `task:` | Optional loop block using default argument `elapsed_seconds`. |
| `task <argument>:` | Optional loop block with a custom elapsed-time argument name. |
| `end:` | Optional cleanup block run when the task runtime ends. |

## Created Channels

| Channel | Direction | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<portal>/<name>_running.value` | writable | Set to `1` to start the task loop, or `0` to stop it. |
| `<portal>/<name>_target_frequency.value` | writable | Requested loop frequency in Hz. Defaults to `10`. |
| `<portal>/<name>_actual_frequency.value` | observe-only | Measured loop frequency in Hz. DCode writes `0` when the task is stopped. |
| `<portal>/<name>_hold.value` | writable | Task hold control. Set to `1` to hold the task without stopping it, or `0` to release it. |

## Snippet

```dcode
task_periodic tasks/name:
    start:
        -- setup

    task elapsed_seconds:
        local current = |portal/channel.value|

    end:
        -- cleanup
```
